name: Docs audit fan-out
goal: Find where the documentation and the product disagree, with evidence, and report the ten that matter most.
description: Twenty-three scouts read one documentation area each and a synthesizer merges their findings. Structurally sound and loop-free, but the document itself has outgrown the budget for rewriting it in one pass, which is what W_DOC_TOO_LARGE is for.

nodes.name: Billing scout
nodes.brief: Read every page under docs/billing/ and the three most recent changelog entries that touch it. Write one file, findings/billing.md, with: what the area promises, what it actually does today, the three places those disagree most, and a line of evidence for each disagreement — a path and a line number, never an adjective. Do not edit anything outside findings/. If the area has no pages, say so in one line and stop rather than inventing material.
